Instructions

Source: INSTRUCTIONS.md

An agent just changed the behavior of Relative multiplicity. It now can handle zero reference diversities with a paramter that caps at a certain maximum, assigning that maximum to when the sample has diversity but the reference does not.

It also made more sofisticated the scheme of how the average works (using the 4 possible combinations of the sample and the reference profile).

Please review that the code changes are correct and the test created check the functionality.

Include a simple toy experiment where there is a refrence diversity and a sample has the same diversity, one has lower diversity and another has higher (double of triple) diversity.

You will be in auto. Please review and give me a small report. I don’t expect anything to be wrong but you are the checker to make sure everything is in order.
